name: juicer-skills
description: Agent skills by the Juicer team — social-signal tools for marketers, powered by the Juicer Data API.

plugins.name: topic-scout
plugins.description: Find blog topics your buyers are actually asking for. Mines competitor brand mentions across Reddit and X (years of real questions, live complaints and outages), detects vendor astroturfing and shows which keywords competitors seed, and flags 'changing right now' events before search volume exists. Every finding carries its source URL.

plugins.name: mention-scout
plugins.description: Find live conversations where your brand can genuinely join in — fresh recommendation-asks, competitor complaints, and unanswered mentions of your brand across Reddit and X. Disclosed engagement only; flags astroturfed threads as traps.
